requirements.requirement: Atomic claims, nonempty lines 3-65, sources and corrected sentences
requirements.finding: 24 claims; 38 required lines covered. Literature access scope remains explicit, not upgraded.

requirements.requirement: Units, independent Liouvillian, jump-count distinction, signed-generator choices
requirements.finding: Independent Kronecker Liouvillian and spectral gaps agree; K+ and |K| differ. GM/c^3 is a time. No physical extension selected.

C1_LEITURAS_E_RELOGIOS.md + C1_TABLES.json implement the requested C1 table under descriptive filenames. Local source rate does not depend directly on distance; propagation is a separate spectral model. Physical clock/partition remain unselected as ordered.

requirements.requirement: Evaluate Gamma/omega, rather than assert it is small for every interpretation
requirements.finding: Dimensionless ratios are evaluated by reading and event. Small Gamma/omega does not itself establish detectability or exclusion; source/clock and QNM domain restrictions apply.

requirements.requirement: Corotation, modular/Killing clock and Kerr state hypotheses
requirements.finding: Positive finite KMS oscillator checked; exact Kerr QNM used for the corotating gap. It is not a construction of the physical Kerr state. Kay-Wald and Milburn were read only at abstract scope; broader claims are not supported here.

requirements.requirement: Ensemble, single trajectories, energy/power, finite occupation and colored noise
requirements.finding: 22 estimator/noise cells, 1100 fits. Colored noise here is declared synthetic OU+white; later C5 uses actual off-source intervals. Large N~10^78 is an analytic initial-slope extrapolation, not an exact finite computation or measured occupation.

requirements.requirement: Public prediction and waveform modules; a=0/1, constants regression and actual consumer
requirements.finding: Legacy A/B within 1e-12; 264 later predictions unchanged; actual Bilby consumers checked. Higher modes need explicit exact QNM and angular projection. Not a full inspiral-merger modified-gravity waveform or pyRing plugin.

requirements.requirement: Actual released samples, prior semantics, file custody and no repeated event evidence
requirements.finding: 33 newer and 18 older products, 12 overlaps. Release-specific combinations are alternatives, never multiplied. Legacy executable/remnant fit and some pyRing merge provenance remain unavailable.

requirements.requirement: Joint densities, sample-dependent predictions, marginals, prior alternatives and GR-relative decisions
requirements.finding: Joint KDE/conditional-curve results, bootstrap/bandwidth controls and two free-clock priors are explicit. Catalog verdict remains INCONCLUSIVE_SYSTEMATICS, including GR-region and local-density qualifications. No ln B-to-sigma conversion.

requirements.requirement: O4/O5 distributions under both hypotheses, PSD controls and full injection matrix
requirements.finding: 4608 cells with 50 paired intervals each, actual off-source O4 noise recolored to design PSDs, two IMR families and six SNRs. Reused intervals are not independent observations; remnant is fixed in this forecast. O5 is a sensitivity scenario, not a promise.

requirements.requirement: Bias <=0.2 and 90% coverage in [0.80,0.97] across both IMR families
requirements.finding: 0 FULL_IMR groups pass both families and both injected amplitudes. Negative result retained. Passing numerical reproduction or a selected cell cannot replace this gate.

requirements.requirement: Nonblind pre-read registration, guards, actual strain and all five starts
requirements.finding: Frozen input hashes still match; all starts converge; full registered strain result reproduced in a fresh copy. Code/input/registration mutations are refused. Physical interpretation remains INCONCLUSIVE_SYSTEMATICS.

requirements.requirement: Comparison with released pyRing analyses at corresponding starts
requirements.finding: Eight released products at 6/8/10/12 tM compared. No 10.5 tM product exists in the inspected release. PSD, trigger, modes and priors differ; identical pyRing inference was not reproduced. This cannot validate model adequacy by itself.

requirements.requirement: English package, event/readout tables, modules and fresh-directory regeneration
requirements.finding: Waveform demo and registered strain reproduced; posterior stages, injection chain and GWTC-3 replay verified. Public URLs/hashes permit download, but this round used local verified archives. Original LVK samplers and independent external review are not claimed.

mathematical_scope: Conditional implications from specified generators/clocks; not a unique physical identification
unresolved_acceptance: C6 pyRing comparison differs in model/priors and lacks a released 10.5 tM product
Physical partition, clock and observed unraveling were intentionally not selected
